questions.question: A managed relational database service that supports multiple engines including MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, and SQL Server. It automates time-consuming tasks such as hardware provisioning, database setup, patching, and backups.
A fully managed NoSQL database service offering single-digit millisecond performance at any scale. It supports both key-value and document data models with automatic scaling.
A cloud-native, MySQL and PostgreSQL-compatible relational database built for the cloud that is up to 5x faster than standard MySQL and 3x faster than standard PostgreSQL.

A fully managed in-memory caching service supporting Redis and Memcached. It improves application performance by retrieving data from fast in-memory caches instead of relying on slower disk-based databases.
A fast, fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse that makes it simple and cost-effective to analyze all your data using standard SQL queries and existing business intelligence tools.
A fully managed graph database service that makes it easy to build and run applications with highly connected data. It supports Gremlin and SPARQL query languages for property graphs and RDF graphs.
A fully managed document database service that is MongoDB-compatible, allowing you to use existing MongoDB drivers and tools while benefiting from managed infrastructure.
A purpose-built time-series database service that makes it fast and cost-effective to store and analyze trillions of events per day from IoT sensors, DevOps monitoring, and industrial telemetry.

A fully managed ledger database that provides a transparent, immutable, and cryptographically verifiable transaction log owned by a central trusted authority, ideal for supply chain and financial records.
